movelist.name: Light Screen
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Light Screen may activate it when receiving Special Damage to resist the Damage one step. Light Screen may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Sweet Scent
movelist.effect: Targets hit by Sweet Scent gain a -2 Penalty to Evasion. (Total Evasion may not be lowered to a negative value. )

movelist.name: Petal Dance
movelist.effect: After damage is dealt, the user becomes Enraged and Confused.

movelist.name: Natural Gift
movelist.effect: Refer to the Move Keywords Berry list. Natural Gift deals damage according to the Berry list and Natural Gift’s Type is also defined there. The Berry’s Digestion Buff is nullified and is not used.

movelist.name: Reflect
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Reflect may activate it when receiving Physical Damage to resist the Damage one step. Reflect may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.effect: The target is cured of all Status conditions.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.effect: The user is cured of one Status Affliction. Leaf Guard’s Frequency is ignored if used during Sunny Weather.

abilities.name: Blessed Touch
abilities.effect: An adjacent Pokémon or Trainer gains Hit Points equal to 1/4th of its maximum Hit Points.
